Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler rejected my request with a missing gateway credential error (`gateway cron.add requires credentials`), so nothing is scheduled yet and nothing has been posted.

Once the scheduler is reachable, I'll set it up as a weekly Monday 08:00 Chicago time post in #coastal-team, starting Monday 19 October. Two limits will apply to the digest:

- It will cover #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both channels have the same three members (you, Kwame, Sofia), so nobody gains visibility they don't already have.
- Money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms) will stay out unless the figure is already in #coastal-team. Otherwise the digest will just note that a finance item exists and that it's with the deal desk.

If you can get someone with gateway admin access to check the scheduler credentials, ask me again and I'll retry. I can also post a one-off digest by hand this week in the meantime.
